2608.23918.title: MARS: Multi-Specialist LLM Relay System for Competitive Programming
2608.23918.paper_summary: Large Language Models excel at code generation, yet competitive programming exposes a persistent failure mode: existing multi-agent pipelines distribute work over generic planner, coder, and debugger roles and delegate the choice of algorithmic technique to the backbone alone. We present MARS (Multi-Agent Relay of Specialized LLMs), a prompt-only framework in which each agent is a topic specialist---dynamic programming, graphs, strings, geometry, and so on---grounded by retrieval-augmented generation over an algorithm-theory corpus. Given a problem, retrieval selects a small team of relevant specialists; a starter writes an initial C++17 solution, and each subsequent turn runs the candidate against public examples in a sandbox, lets the active specialist keep, repair, or hand off the draft, and forwards a structured packet to the next specialist. A single infrastructure-fixer pass normalizes boilerplate at the end. On the CodeContests test split with Gemma 4, MARS reaches $0.624 \pm 0.006$ pass rate at $2.3$ recorded pipeline stages per task ($+14.4$ percentage points over direct prompting), closing most of the gap to CodeSIM ($0.731$) at $3.3{\times}$ lower wall-clock cost and substantially smaller variance in per-task token spend. The source code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/fckand/mars.
2608.23918.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在程式碼生成方面表現出色，但競爭性編程揭示了一個持續的失敗模式：現有的多代理管道將工作分配給通用的規劃者、編碼者和除錯者角色，並將算法技術的選擇僅委託給主幹。我們提出了MARS（多代理專門化大型語言模型的中繼），這是一個僅基於提示的框架，其中每個代理都是主題專家——動態規劃、圖形、字串、幾何等等——基於增強檢索生成的算法理論語料庫。給定一個問題，檢索選擇一小組相關的專家；一名啟動者編寫初始的C++17解決方案，隨後的每一輪都在沙盒中運行候選者，讓活躍的專家保留、修復或轉交草稿，並將結構化的數據包轉發給下一位專家。最後進行一次基礎設施修正過程，以標準化樣板。在Gemma 4的CodeContests測試分割中，MARS達到了$0.624 \pm 0.006$的通過率，每個任務記錄的管道階段為$2.3$（比直接提示提高了$+14.4$個百分點），大幅縮小了與CodeSIM ($0.731$)之間的差距，並在每個任務的令牌消耗上顯著減少了變異性。源代碼可在GitHub上獲得：https://github.com/fckand/mars。
